1.web: After this, David struck the Philistines, and subdued them; and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.
1.asv: And after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them: and David took the bridle of the mother city out of the hand of the Philistines.

2.web: He struck Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. The Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.
2.asv: And he smote Moab, and measured them with the line, making them to lie down on the ground; and he measured two lines to put to death, and one full line to keep alive. And the Moabites became servants to David, and brought tribute.

3.web: David struck also Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.
3.asv: David smote also Hadadezer the son of Rehob, king of Zobah, as he went to recover his dominion at the River.

4.web: David took from him one thousand seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David hamstrung all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for one hundred chariots.
4.asv: And David took from him a thousand and seven hundred horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: and David hocked all the chariot horses, but reserved of them for a hundred chariots.

5.web: When the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadadezer king of Zobah, David struck of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
5.asv: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to succor Hadadezer king of Zobah, David smote of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.

6.web: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
6.asv: Then David put garrisons in Syria of Damascus; and the Syrians became servants to David, and brought tribute. And Jehovah gave victory to David whithersoever he went.

7.web: David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
7.asv: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadadezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.

8.web: From Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.
8.asv: And from Betah and from Berothai, cities of Hadadezer, king David took exceeding much brass.

9.web: When Toi king of Hamath heard that David had struck all the army of Hadadezer,
9.asv: And when Toi king of Hamath heard that David had smitten all the host of Hadadezer,

10.web: then Toi sent Joram his son to king David, to greet him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and struck him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:
10.asv: then Toi sent Joram his son unto king David, to salute him, and to bless him, because he had fought against Hadadezer and smitten him: for Hadadezer had wars with Toi. And Joram brought with him vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and vessels of brass:

11.web: King David also dedicated these to Yahweh, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued;
11.asv: these also did king David dedicate unto Jehovah, with the silver and gold that he dedicated of all the nations which he subdued;

12.web: of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the plunder of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.
12.asv: of Syria, and of Moab, and of the children of Ammon, and of the Philistines, and of Amalek, and of the spoil of Hadadezer, son of Rehob, king of Zobah.

13.web: David earned a reputation when he returned from smiting the Syrians in the Valley of Salt, even eighteen thousand men.
13.asv: And David gat him a name when he returned from smiting the Syrians in the Valley of Salt, even eighteen thousand men.

14.web: He put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. Yahweh gave victory to David wherever he went.
14.asv: And he put garrisons in Edom; throughout all Edom put he garrisons, and all the Edomites became servants to David. And Jehovah gave victory to David whithersoever he went.

15.web: David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness to all his people.
15.asv: And David reigned over all Israel; and David executed justice and righteousness unto all his people.

16.web: Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the army; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;
16.asv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud was recorder;

17.web: and Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Seraiah was scribe;
17.asv: and Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, were priests; and Seraiah was scribe;

18.web: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.
18.asv: and Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David’s sons were chief ministers.
